blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Second Congressional Commission on Education (Edcom 2) has welcomed President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s new policy allowing school-level decisions on class suspensions and resumptions, saying it could help minimize learning disruptions while ensuring the safety of learners and teachers as the country braces for a prolonged El Niño. In a statement on Tuesday, Edcom 2 said Executive Order (EO) No. 130 replaces the blanket class suspension policies with a framework that allows decisions to be based on actual conditions and risks in affected communities and schools. EO 130 establishes three levels of decision-making: automatic suspensions based on nationally prescribed […]...
